title: Universality of the abelian stage-section cocone
statement: Let J, F, the precoverages P_j, the cocone V, and Q satisfy the hypotheses of the abelian colimit-site inverse-image formula: J is small filtered; P_j have isomorphism covers, finite composition and base-change closure, covering pullbacks and finite covering presieves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage]. Transitions map covering presieves to covering presieves, preserve covering pullbacks and are continuous. The object and arrow cocones of V are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. The Q covers are precisely transported images of stage covers; Q has the same finite closure and pullback properties, and each V_j is continuous and preserves covering pullbacks. Fix i, an abelian sheaf G on P_i, and U in F(i). Supply alpha_t and theta_b satisfying the two adjunction unit equations described in the stage-section diagram statement [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-site-abelian-section-diagram]. Supply a diagram D on Under(i), component isomorphisms E_t to the stage inverse-image sections, a cocone K, and an isomorphism e from K.pt to the limit inverse-image sections. Suppose K_t followed by e equals E_t followed by alpha_t on sections, and E_t followed by theta_b on sections equals D(b) followed by E_t', both as equalities in the arrow category. Then K is a colimit cocone: Nonempty(IsColimit K). All diagram, cocone and comparison data are inputs, not objects asserted to exist.

proof.text: Use the stage-representative lemma for e.hom(x). If its representative is y at t, choose z = E-t.inv(y). The hK arrow equality implies heterogeneous equality between e.hom(K-t(z)) and alpha-t(y). The inverse-hom equation of E-t cancels its inverse. Transitivity with the representative equality and injectivity of e.hom give K-t(z) = x. Thus the underlying cocone is jointly surjective. The private arrow_apply_heq helper is proved by taking equality of arrow targets and then Arrow.mk_inj.

For x,y in D(t) whose K-t images agree, hK transfers their equality to alpha-t(E-t.hom(x)) = alpha-t(E-t.hom(y)). Apply the eventual-equality lemma to get b : t to t-prime equating their theta images. The hD arrow equality transfers this equality to E-t-prime.hom(D(b)(x)) = E-t-prime.hom(D(b)(y)). Injectivity of E-t-prime.hom gives D(b)(x) = D(b)(y). The private arrow_kernel_iff helper is proved by equality of arrow targets and Arrow.mk_inj.

Under i is filtered by Mathlib CategoryTheory.IsFiltered.under. Apply Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf-prime to the forgotten cocone, using the two preceding elementwise conditions. The abelian forgetful functor preserves filtered colimits and reflects isomorphisms, so reflectsColimit_of_reflectsIsomorphisms supplies reflection of this colimit. Apply isColimitOfReflects and wrap the resulting IsColimit witness in Nonempty. All objects remain supplied data; no definition or signature changes.

lean.statement:
theorem colimit_site_abelian_section_universality
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck
          Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
          t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : ∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app
        (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (D : Under i ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (E : ∀ t : Under i, D.obj t ≅
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (K : Cocone D) (e : K.pt ≅ ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
      i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hK : ∀ t : Under i, Arrow.mk (K.ι.app t ≫ e.hom) =
      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫ (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))))
    (hD : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫ (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) =
      Arrow.mk (D.map b ≫ (E t').hom)) : Nonempty (IsColimit K)
